title: weivel library declaration
description: The machine-readable description of a C library: the binary to load and the services its functions offer to plugins.

$schema.description: Pointer at the published declaration schema, for an editor's completion and validation.

id.description: The library's permanent identity, matching its repository name.
id.fix: use lowercase words joined by single hyphens, for example "echo"

version.fix: set "version" to the library's version, for example "0.1.0"

binary.description: The shared library's base name, without a platform prefix or extension.
binary.fix: use a C identifier for the binary's base name, for example "echo"

release.description: The exported symbol that frees a buffer the library returned.
release.fix: name the exported release function as a C identifier, for example "echo_release"

services.description: The services this library offers to plugins.

items.description: One service and the functions it exposes.

id.fix: use lowercase words joined by single hyphens, for example "echo"

items.description: One exported function, called with and answering JSON.

name.description: The name a plugin calls the function by.
name.fix: start "name" with a lowercase letter and use letters and digits only, for example "repeat"

symbol.description: The exported C symbol that implements the function.
symbol.fix: use a C identifier for the exported symbol, for example "echo_repeat"

kind.description: How the function is called: JSON in, JSON out.
kind.fix: set "kind" to "json", the only kind there is

argument.description: A JSON Schema the call's argument must satisfy.

result.description: A JSON Schema the call's result satisfies.
